name: NGC 4875 (Webb)
blurb: NGC 4875, a galaxy in the Coma Cluster, seen by Webb.
label: ngc4875-webb
story: A companion of the giant galaxy NGC 4874 in the crowded core of the Coma Cluster. Webb observed it to help measure the distance to the cluster, a key touchstone for the cosmic distance scale.

claims.text: NGC 4875 is a member of the Coma Cluster
NGC 4875 is a companion of NGC 4874 in the core of the Coma Cluster (Abell 1656)
NGC 4874 is a giant elliptical galaxy
NGC-4875 is a target of Webb program 5989, the JWST SBF Coma Cluster Survey for building a distance ladder
The Coma Cluster is a key touchstone for the extragalactic distance scale
